metadata.selection_rule: highest positive mean daily RankIC after 0.70 absolute rank-correlation deduplication
metadata.availability_policy: The annual ROE and annual net-profit-growth bundle becomes usable on the first provider session strictly after max(query_profit_data.pubDate, query_growth_data.pubDate). Daily PB is observed at the trade-date close for next-session execution.
metadata.revision_policy: BaoStock exposes the current historical snapshot with pubDate/statDate but no revision vintages. The protocol prevents ordinary announcement look-ahead but cannot reconstruct superseded historical values.
